sop: SOP-QA-040 Retention and archiving of GMP records (synthetic)

ranking.title: 211.87 Retesting of approved components, drug product containers, and closures.

rows.text: Any production, control, or distribution record that is required to be maintained in compliance with this part and is specifically associated with a batch of a drug product shall be retained for at least 1 year after the expiration date of the batch or, in the case of certain OTC drug products lacking expiration dating because they meet the criteria for exemption under § 211.137, 3 years after distribution of the batch.

passages.text:
2. Scope

Applies to all production, laboratory, distribution and complaint records of products made at the Chennai site, on paper or electronic. Every product made at the site carries an expiry date.

3. Retention periods

3.1 The batch manufacturing and packaging records, laboratory records and distribution records of a batch are kept for at least one year after the expiry date of that batch. 3.2 Records of raw materials, containers, closures and labels (receipt, test and issue records) are kept for two years after the material is received.

5. Annual product review

5.1 Once a year QA reviews, for every product, the records of a representative number of batches, approved and rejected, with their associated records, to decide whether the specifications or the manufacturing or control procedures need to change. 5.2 The review also covers the year's complaints, recalls, returned and salvaged goods and every investigation made for the product.

To define how long GMP records are kept, where they are kept, how they are shown to inspectors and how they are used in the annual product review.

rows.text: All records required under this part, or copies of such records, shall be readily available for authorized inspection during the retention period at the establishment where the activities described in such records occurred.

passages.text:
3. Retention periods

3.1 The batch manufacturing and packaging records, laboratory records and distribution records of a batch are kept for at least one year after the expiry date of that batch. 3.2 Records of raw materials, containers, closures and labels (receipt, test and issue records) are kept for two years after the material is received.

4. Storage and access

4.1 Records are kept at the Chennai site in the fire-proof document archive, or as scanned true copies in the electronic document system once QA has checked the scan against the original. 4.2 During its retention period every record is readily available at the site to inspectors of the regulatory authority, who may photocopy it or have it printed. 4.3 Electronic records held on the company server in Mumbai count as available when they can be printed at the site at once. 4.4 Microfilm is not used.

6. Destruction

At the end of its retention period a record is destroyed only with the written approval of QA, and the destruction is entered in the archive log.
